title: OSS Receives $1 Million Follow-On Production Order from a Leading Defense and Intelligence Contractor
summary: Latest award expands OSS’s role in a next-generation platform for mission-critical electronic warfare simulation Ninth order since May 2025 brings cumulative orders to nearly $5 million, with additional opportunities expected in 2027 and 2028 ESCONDIDO, Calif. – October 8, 2026 – One Stop Systems, Inc. (OSS or the Company) (Nasdaq: OSS), a leader in rugged Enterprise Class compute for artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML) and sensor processing at the edge, today announced that a leading defense and intelligence contractor has placed a new $1 million follow-on production order in support of a next-generation GNSS testing and simulation platform. This is the ninth order from this customer since the relationship began in May 2025 and brings total orders to date to nearly an aggregate $5 million. OSS expects additional opportunities in 2027 and 2028 to support this testing and simulation platform. Under the latest award, OSS will provide its Gen 5 PCIe 4U short-depth server (SDS) as the compute foundation for the customer’s next-generation GNSS simulation platform. The platform is a multi-element, phase-coherent GNSS simulator designed specifically for Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna (CRPA) testing and can simultaneously simulate multiple threats, including jamming, spoofing and repeating. The follow-on award reflects continued expansion of OSS’ role in supporting the customer’s high-fidelity simulation environments for electronic warfare signal processing and complex antenna-array modeling. “We are thrilled to build on this relationship and support the next generation of the customer’s GNSS simulation platform,” said Mike Knowles, President and CEO of OSS. “Being selected again as the program advances from Gen 2 to Gen 3 reflects what we believe is the value of our rugged, Enterprise Class compute architecture and our ability to integrate the latest GPU and CPU technologies into proven edge platforms.” Knowles continued, “We are increasingly seeing initial platform wins develop into recurring production opportunities as customers move from development into deployment. Based on current program expectations, OSS anticipates potential additional orders on this program in 2027 and 2028. These hardware and software platforms bring the latest data center performance to harsh and challenging applications, whether they are on land, sea or in the air. OSS products include ruggedized servers, compute accelerators, flash storage arrays, and storage acceleration software. These specialized compact products are used across multiple industries and applications, including autonomous trucking and farming, as well as aircraft, drones, ships and vehicles within the defense industry. OSS solutions address the overall AI workflow, from high-speed data acquisition to deep learning, training and large-scale inference, and have delivered many industry firsts for industrial OEM and government customers. *Latest award expands OSS’s role in a next-generation platform for mission-critical electronic warfare simulation* ******


*Ninth order since May 2025 brings cumulative orders to nearly $5 million, with additional opportunities expected in 2027 and 2028*


****


**ESCONDIDO, Calif. – October 8, 2026** –


One Stop Systems, Inc. (OSS or the Company) (Nasdaq: OSS), a leader in rugged Enterprise Class compute for artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML) and sensor processing at the edge, today announced that a leading defense and intelligence contractor has placed a new $1 million follow-on production order in support of a next-generation GNSS testing and simulation platform. This is the ninth order from this customer since the relationship began in May 2025 and brings total orders to date to nearly an aggregate $5 million. OSS expects additional opportunities in 2027 and 2028 to support this testing and simulation platform.


****


Under the latest award, OSS will provide its Gen 5 PCIe 4U short-depth server (SDS) as the compute foundation for the customer’s next-generation GNSS simulation platform. The platform is a multi-element, phase-coherent GNSS simulator designed specifically for Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna (CRPA) testing and can simultaneously simulate multiple threats, including jamming, spoofing and repeating. The follow-on award reflects continued expansion of OSS’ role in supporting the customer’s high-fidelity simulation environments for electronic warfare signal processing and complex antenna-array modeling.


****


“We are thrilled to build on this relationship and support the next generation of the customer’s GNSS simulation platform,” said Mike Knowles, President and CEO of OSS. “Being selected again as the program advances from Gen 2 to Gen 3 reflects what we believe is the value of our rugged, Enterprise Class compute architecture and our ability to integrate the latest GPU and CPU technologies into proven edge platforms.”


****


Knowles continued, “We are increasingly seeing initial platform wins develop into recurring production opportunities as customers move from development into deployment. Based on current program expectations, OSS anticipates potential additional orders on this program in 2027 and 2028. We believe it may be another example of the growing base of multi-year platform opportunities we are developing across our defense and commercial markets.”


****


**About One Stop Systems**
One Stop Systems, Inc. (Nasdaq: OSS) is a leader in AI enabled solutions for the demanding 'edge'. OSS designs and manufactures Enterprise Class compute and storage products that enable rugged AI, sensor fusion and autonomous capabilities without compromise. These hardware and software platforms bring the latest data center performance to harsh and challenging applications, whether they are on land, sea or in the air.


OSS products include ruggedized servers, compute accelerators, flash storage arrays, and storage acceleration software. These specialized compact products are used across multiple industries and applications, including autonomous trucking and farming, as well as aircraft, drones, ships and vehicles within the defense industry.


OSS solutions address the overall AI workflow, from high-speed data acquisition to deep learning, training and large-scale inference, and have delivered many industry firsts for industrial OEM and government customers.


As one of the fastest growing segments of the multi-billion-dollar edge computing market, AI enabled solutions require-and OSS delivers-the highest level of performance in the most challenging environments without compromise.


OSS products are available directly or through global distributors. For more information, go to[www.onestopsystems.com](https://www.onestopsystems.com/) . You can also follow OSS on[X](https://x.com/_OneStopSystems) ,[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/user/onestopsystems) , and[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/one-stop-systems/) .
